Definition: Haran, the name of two men
BiblicalUsage: Haran is the name of two men, and the first is the one the story remembers. In Genesis 11:26 Terah begat Abram, Nahor and Haran, in Genesis 11:27 Haran is named as the father of Lot, and in 1 Chronicles 23:9 a later Haran appears among the sons of Shimei the Levite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Haran matters because of who came from him: Lot, whose rescue would shape Abraham's whole story, and a family line that runs straight into the promise.
